name: No Bezel
short_description: Just a plain LED through a hole. Position can be customized to your graphics.
long_description: No LED bezel or mounting hardware. The LED will be mounted directly through the enclosure. Choose this if you want a minimalist look.

name: Simple LED Bezel
short_description: You're a basic bitch? Take this basic LED mounting bezel
long_description: Simple chrome LED bezel. Provides a clean and compact mounting solution for 3mm or 5mm LEDs.

name: Wide Chrome LED Bezel
short_description: You're a fancy bitch? Take this fancy LED mounting bezel
long_description: A big wider chrome LED bezel. Provides a clean, mounting solution for 3mm or 5mm LEDs.

name: Lampshade
short_description: A stylish lampshade for your LED.
long_description: A plastic lampshade that diffuses the LED light softly, adding a warm glow to your pedal. Perfect for a vintage or cozy aesthetic.

name: Alarm Lampshade
short_description: A flat, alarm-style lampshade for your LED.
long_description: A flat lampshade that gives your LED a bold, industrial look. The flat-top design reaches out of the enclosure and diffuses light in a unique way, making it a literal standout feature on your pedal.

name: Fender Style Jewel
long_description: Classic Fender amplifier-style jewel indicator light. Features a domed lens that diffuses LED light beautifully. Available in various colors (red, amber, green, blue). Adds authentic vintage aesthetics to your build.

name: Illuminated Footswitch
short_description: You're all in for that high tech stuff, huh?
long_description: Footswitch with integrated LED illumination. The switch itself lights up when the pedal is active. Modern, clean look that eliminates the need for a separate indicator LED.

name: No LED
short_description: I dont know why you'd want that, but ok.
long_description: No LED indicator light included with your pedal. The enclosure will be prepared without any LED drilling or mounting provisions.
